summary: Public articles style and harden display of gallery, media, file, bookmark, product, toggle, and markup blocks.
detailed_changes: Added prose styles for gallery, video, audio, file, bookmark, product, toggle, and markup blocks.
Gallery skips empty image URLs and no longer nests figures; video and audio expose accessible names.
Empty toggle titles and empty media URLs fail closed; product titles use a non-heading element.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public readers of articles with rich media cards; staff authors of those blocks
Public impact: richer card layout and clearer media labels on published articles
Internal impact: BlockRenderer fail-closed behaviour for corrupt/empty media fields
